model: Z faults with probability p on every input; kappa = sum over accepted pairs within one sub-factory run of (1 - target fidelity)

batch_search.note: kappa of the batch is the minimum found over gate-to-block assignments and per-gate block orientations (CCZ: which block output feeds which qubit; CS: which output is Y-measured and the order of the other two), exhaustive over assignments x Y qubit when m <= 4, then best-improvement local search over the full space; an upper bound on the minimum of this construction, which is itself one construction of [[6m+2,3m,2]]

cat_per_T.note: kappa_cat = (B-1) K2 + (K1 if tau odd else K2), B = ceil(tau/2); carried: K2_carried for all blocks but the last
